postings.description:

Why we're hiring:

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive  Data Analyst to be a critical hands-on contributor to our client reporting and analytics initiatives within WPP Open. Reporting directly to the Data Analytics Lead, you will be responsible for translating complex business questions into robust analytical solutions, going beyond descriptive reporting to identify patterns, drive predictive insights, and deliver actionable intelligence to our client teams. 

This role is for an expert practitioner who thrives on diving deep into data, possesses exceptional SQL skills, and has a proven track record of delivering impactful analytical products. You will play a key role in executing the data strategy defined by the Lead, ensuring data accuracy, and championing innovative analytical approaches. 

What you'll be doing:

Advanced Data Analysis & Insight Generation: 

- Perform complex, hands-on data analysis to identify key trends, patterns, and anomalies in client usage data from the WPP Open platform. 

- Go beyond standard reporting by conducting in-depth investigations, root cause analysis, and contributing to predictive insights to proactively identify opportunities and risks. 

- Develop and implement analytical models and methodologies to extract meaningful insights from large, diverse datasets.

- Utilize very strong SQL skills to query, transform, and analyze data efficiently from various data warehouses, ensuring data integrity and accuracy. 

Reporting & Dashboarding Delivery: 

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, actionable dashboards and reports using various BI tools, serving as a primary delivery expert for monthly and ad-hoc client reporting.

- Ensure all reporting is accurate, consistent, and provides clear, concise narratives that drive understanding and action. 

- Continuously optimize existing reports and build new ones based on evolving client needs and strategic direction from the Lead. 

Technical Execution & Collaboration: 

- Work closely with the Lead to understand strategic objectives and translate them into concrete analytical and reporting deliverables. 

- Collaborate effectively with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure data availability, quality, and the implementation of efficient data pipelines. 

- Provide technical expertise and contribute to the definition of data models and analytical frameworks. 

Stakeholder Communication & Problem Solving: 

- Clearly communicate complex analytical findings, methodologies, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Proactively identify data-related challenges and propose innovative solutions to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and analytical capabilities. 

- Act as a subject matter expert for client usage data on WPP Open. 

What you'll need:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or a closely related quantitative field. 

Experience: 

- 5+ years of overall industry experience of dedicated, hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles. 

- Proven experience in delivering complex analytical projects from data extraction to insight presentation. 

- Direct experience with product analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, Pendo, Amplitude etc. is must 

Technical Skills: 

- Very strong expertise in SQL (advanced queries, performance tuning, data modeling, stored procedures, etc.) is essential. 

- Proficiency with large-scale data warehouses/platforms such as Google BigQuery, Databricks, and AWS data services (e.g., Redshift, S3, Glue, Athena). 

- Advanced proficiency in data visualization and business intelligence tool Power BI for dashboard creation and interactive reporting. 

- Demonstrated experience with statistical analysis techniques and concepts related to predictive modelling. 

- Familiarity with data governance, data quality best practices, and ETL/ELT processes. 

Analytical & Soft Skills: 

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen ability to identify patterns, draw conclusions, and translate data into actionable business insights.

- A 'think differently' mindset, proactively seeking out opportunities for deeper analysis and predictive insights rather than just fulfilling report requests. 

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to diverse audiences. 

- Self-motivated, able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Master's degree in a quantitative field. 

- Experience within an advertising, marketing, or media agency environment. 

- Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis, statistical modelling, or automation. 

- Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Certified, AWS Certified, Databricks Certified).

postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Senior FullStack Engineer
WPP Open · Engineering · Gurugram

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first.
• Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook.
• Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care.
• Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
• Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes.
• Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server.
• Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions.
• Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly.

Minimum qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python.

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

• Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions.

• Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth.

• React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the 
features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services.

• APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline.

• Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons.

• Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks.

• Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined 
as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload.

• Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and
own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests.

• Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews 
when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production.

• Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline.

• Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that 
changes do not break the people who depend on your service.

• Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.

• Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions.

• Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:
• B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
• Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale.
• Experience with Kafka and change data capture.
• Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber.
• Experience with Bigtable.
• Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
• Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

JOB SUMMARY

As an Account Executive at GCI Health, you will play an important role in ensuring that audiences experience our clients’ brands consistently, at all touchpoints, driving the greatest impact while retaining and building new business. You will support account teams’ day-to-day activities, providing exceptional client service and participating in integrated marketing communications (IMC), planning, execution and measurement activities. Key responsibilities include crafting professional, client-facing communications – such as updates on media opportunities, status reports, campaign summary reports and general account activity reports – so being a proactive and detail-oriented team member is a must!

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Service:

- Keep up with the industry. Learn everything you can about your clients and understand the trends and issues (e.g., media, business, political and cultural) that could impact them, their competitors and the overall patient journey.

- Participate in client planning meetings and calls. Ask informed questions and absorb important details.

- Create professional, actionable client-facing communications (e.g., updates on media opportunities, status reports, campaign summary reports and general account activity reports).

- Demonstrate proficiency with document review systems (e.g., Veeva Vault). Be able to upload error-free, quickly and in high-pressure situations. 

Strategy:

- Ask. Wonder. Learn. Read presentation decks, listen in meetings, understand not just what you are doing but why it is being done, and how it adds value to our clients’ businesses.

- Be responsible for tactical execution of client programming and able to deliver first drafts of next-step recommendations, campaign materials, timelines and briefs.

- Contribute to IMC programs in a way that creates value and showcases our “Do Something Different” approach to meeting client objectives. 

Media:

- Develop and maintain media lists and leverage relationships in collaboration with the GCI Health media team. Study and deliver well-written materials.

- Monitor and report client media coverage. Understand how to use media platforms such as Cision and Factiva. Translate and communicate to clients in a way that adds value to their business.

- Research, develop and pitch fresh, thought-provoking stories, and help coordinate press materials and events (such as press kits, news releases and press conferences).

- Know the media landscape – including editorial calendars and subscribing to media newsletters. 

Digital:

- Monitor, pitch and help build relationships with key social influencers and community contacts to optimize digital channels.

- Stay current on social media channels, trends and analytics tools and make recommendations to strengthen client campaigns.

- Develop content for social and digital channels to support brand strategies and appeal to target audiences.

- Communicate and collaborate with the GCI Health digital team, as appropriate. 

Creativity:

- Organize and participate in brainstorming meetings and contribute ideas based on knowledge of the client and outside reading and research.

- Know our capabilities and when to engage creative resources.

- Be curious. Note the latest trends in media, culture, healthcare innovation, etc., and apply them to clients’ programs by presenting a thoughtful and comprehensive POV. 

Research and Insights:

- Know research and measurement methodologies and resources.

- Implement research and measurement tools for client campaigns so we can measure success.

- Synthesize research for analysis and summary reports for teams and clients. 

Business Development:

- Listen. Every client meeting can lead to opportunities to add value and grow the relationship.

- Monitor social media and other channels for relevant opportunities that could lead to new business; proactively flag with supporting rationale to core account team.

- Assist with case studies for client presentations, new business pitches and industry awards.

- Participate in new business research projects. 

Collaboration:

- Share ideas; jump in when needed and ask others for their opinions and builds.

- Weigh potential solutions and compromises based on what they mean to us and our clients. Be ready to defend your position confidently and articulately.

- If people disagree, help find a solution everyone’s happy with; know when to involve a manager. 

Communication:

- Know your audience; use language, style and tone that appeal to them. Communicate efficiently.

- Meet or beat deadlines. Clearly communicate with clients and teams when deadlines shift.

- Be professional when communicating to co-workers, clients and external audiences; skip jargon and clichés. Write with clarity and accuracy.

- Follow AP Stylebook (or AMA, pending client preference) guidelines when writing press materials; understand how to reference. 

Financial Management:

- Learn “the business” of our business and how we make money through meeting billability targets.

- Record billable hours daily in Maconomy and make supervisors aware of your time.

- Follow agency procedures for client budgets and budget tracking.

- Manage vendor relationships, costs and invoicing. 

Diversity and Inclusion:

- Create an inclusive and welcoming environment.

- Demonstrate flexibility in a changing work environment.

- Bridge differences between and among yourself and others.

- Seek out and use ideas, opinions, and insights from diverse sources and individuals.

- Use self-awareness to deflect biases.

- Consistently demonstrate integrity and credibility while building trust through inclusive behavior. 

Team Management:

- Coach and mentor junior team members (account coordinators and assistant account executives) to help them learn our business and capabilities.

- Delegate tasks to junior team members with clarity, including timetables and expected outcomes.

- Identify and implement skills-development needs for team members.

- Review the work of junior team members and provide constructive feedback and edits where appropriate. 

Accountability:

- Fulfill all commitments of your role.

- Admit mistakes and misjudgments. Figure out how to avoid them in the future.

- Take responsibility for tough decisions and actions to get things done.

- Be a problem-solver. 

Agency Responsibilities:

- Help recruit top talent by knowing our capabilities, locations and talking about the company in a positive way.

- Contribute to the agency in a meaningful way through participation in culture initiatives, staff meetings, manager meetings and by being supportive of and kind to colleagues.

- Adhere to GCI Health’s confidentiality and disclosure agreements and code of ethics/conduct.

- Participate in agency Learning and Development opportunities as appropriate and as agreed upon with your manager.

- Do Something Different in your approach, involvement and agency contributions!

*The job description is a summary of typical job functions and is not an exhaustive list of possible duties. The jobholder’s responsibilities and duties may differ from those outlined above. Other duties, as assigned, may be part of the job.

We know we learn best when Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) are embedded into everything we do for our people, agency, clients and communities we serve. We wholly believe that creative truly inclusive and innovative solutions by growing talent that mirrors the marketplace is critical to our success. To that end, we strongly encourage applications from talent across all dimensions of race/ethnicity, LGBTQ, differently abled and veteran status to come and grow with us.

#LI-DNP

The role is responsible for leading and overseeing end-to-end cloud operations, ensuring the availability, reliability, security, performance, and resilience of cloud platforms and services. The role also provides governance over a large third-party managed services organisation, ensuring delivery against agreed KPIs, SLAs, and operational commitments through effective service reviews, metrics reporting, performance management, and continuous service improvement.

What you'll be doing:

Responsible for overseeing cloud operations, driving operational excellence, and improving the operational landscape through automation and AI-driven solutions delivered by internal resources and third-party partnerships.

Product: 

- Work with product and engineering teams to define operational support patterns for each cloud product.

- Collaborate with business, architecture, engineering, cybersecurity, and platform teams to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement.

Operational Excellence: 

The role oversees cloud infrastructure monitoring and ensures support is provided when issues occur across the following domains:

- Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure & GCP)

- Databases

- Citrix

- CMDB & scope management

- FinOps

- Patching

- Vulnerability Management

- Backup

- Incident, Problem, and Change Management

- Compliance & Audit support

Automation: Define and drive the cloud operations strategy through automation, AIOps, and AI-driven capabilities to enable predictive operations, intelligent incident management, and operational excellence. - Define and execute the Cloud Operations strategy and operating model, aligning operational objectives with business and technology priorities.

- Act as the senior operational escalation point for critical incidents, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and timely service restoration.

- Establish and monitor operational dashboards, KPIs, service health metrics, and executive reporting to drive data-driven decision-making.

- Ensure cloud operations comply with security, risk, audit, regulatory, and governance requirements.

- Lead operational readiness, capacity planning, resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity for cloud services.

- Collaborate with business, architecture, engineering, cybersecurity, and platform teams to ensure seamless service delivery and continual improvement.

- Own performance reporting and provide clear, actionable insights to support operational governance and decision-making.

- Ensure cloud infrastructure is regularly checked to maintain availability, meet performance SLAs, and complete performance tuning and runbook activities when required.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

- Solid experience in IT Infrastructure and Cloud Operations, with significant experience leading enterprise-scale cloud operations.

- Proven experience managing cloud platforms (Azure, Google, and/or AWS Cloud Platform) and hybrid cloud environments.

- Demonstrated experience leading large Cloud Operations teams, including governance of third-party managed service providers.

- Proven experience managing vendor performance through KPIs, SLAs, OLAs, contractual governance, Management Service Reviews (MSRs), and continuous service improvement.

- Strong understanding of cloud operations, infrastructure management, site reliability, operational resilience, and service lifecycle management.

- Experience driving operational transformation through automation, AIOps, AI-enabled operations, and self-service capabilities.

- Strong knowledge of ITSM processes, including Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Availability, Capacity, and Service Level Management.

postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

Why we're hiring:

The Enterprise Security Architect at WPP will be a pivotal role, responsible for defining and evolving the security architecture within WPP. This role ensures that WPP's technology landscape is designed with security, resilience, and compliance as fundamental pillars. The architect will bridge the gap between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technical implementation, specifically focusing on embedding security best practices.

Operating heavily in the Cyber Risk and Compliance function, the role will have a strong Security Operations architecture focus and will be key to ensuring the Security Operations function is successful and effective. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the security foundation of one of the world's leading creative transformation companies. You will work on cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with diverse global teams, and directly contribute to protecting WPP's intellectual property, client data, and brand reputation in an evolving digital landscape.

What you'll be doing:

Security Architecture Strategy: Develop, maintain, and communicate the domain-specific security architecture vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with WPP's overall enterprise security strategy and business goals.

Secure Design & Development: Provide expert architectural guidance and oversight for key projects and initiatives within the domain, advocating for secure design principles, patterns, and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

 Compliance & Governance: Ensure that architectural designs and implementations adhere to relevant regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001) and internal security policies. Participate in security audits and assessments, translating findings into actionable architectural improvements.

 Threat & Risk Management: Conduct architectural risk assessments and threat modelling within the domain, identifying potential vulnerabilities and recommending appropriate mitigating controls. Integrate risk management practices into architectural decision-making.

 Cybersecurity Integration: Embed advanced cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and best practices (e.g., identity and access management, data protection, network security, incident response capabilities) into the domain's architecture.

Standards & Patterns: Define and promote security architecture standards, guidelines, and reusable patterns for the domain to foster consistency, efficiency, and robustness across solutions. Create associated designs and artefacts as the requirement arises. 

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with other Enterprise Architects, Security Operations, CISO office, Development Teams, Product Owners, and Legal/Compliance to translate security requirements into technical solutions and gain consensus on solutions and architectural direction.

Technology Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and recommend new security technologies and architectural approaches that can enhance the security posture and efficiency of the domain.

Documentation & Communication: Create clear, concise, and comprehensive security architecture documentation, including diagrams, principles, and decision records. Effectively communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Security Solution Architecture: When required, form, lead and contribute to successful deliver of specific security solutions and workstreams.

- Bachelors\master’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field.

- Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or CCSP are highly desirable.

- Architectural Expertise: Proven experience (2+ years) as an Enterprise Architect, Domain Architect, or Security Architect in a large, complex enterprise environment, preferably within the advertising, media, or professional services industry.

- Security Frameworks: Deep understanding and practical experience with security architecture frameworks (e.g., NIST, SABSA, TOGAF-ADM with security overlays) and industry best practices.

- Cybersecurity Knowledge: Strong understanding of contemporary cybersecurity threats, attack vectors, and defence mechanisms. Experience with various security domains including application security, infrastructure security, data security, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), and identity management.

- Compliance Acumen: Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and other relevant industry compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2).

- Analytical & Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to decompose complex security challenges into manageable architectural solutions.

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

- Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.

- Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.

- Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.

- Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

- Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.

- Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.

- Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

- Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.

Strategic Initiatives & Applied Research works at the intersection of emerging technology, client
demand and WPP’s product strategy. We build production-lite solutions to test strategically
important opportunities, prove their technical and commercial value, and turn successful work
into reusable capabilities for Product and Engineering.

agent-to-agent workflows, new platform connections and other emerging opportunities to help
shape the future of WPP’s products. We want generalists who are happy to move onto the next
frontier problem once this one is proven.

Forward Deployed Engineers are hands-on product engineers who work close to clients,
publishers and the market. You will combine technical depth with commercial understanding and
consultancy-style problem solving: helping to define a problem, building the solution, testing it in
a real setting and translating what works into reusable technical capability.

validation, sensible testing and graceful failure rather than creating either disposable
prototypes or prematurely over-engineered systems.

to scale.

- experience in software engineering, data science or a related field, with a track record of
getting things into real use.

- Strong Python and hands-on cloud experience

- Demonstrable experience building agentic/LLM systems - tool and structured calling
orchestration, evaluation, and a realistic view of what breaks when you try to get
production value out of them.

- Consultancy-style experience gained through consulting, professional services, solutions
engineering, forward deployment or an internal business-transformation function.

- Strong product and commercial judgement, with the ability to communicate technical
choices and business implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity, learning unfamiliar domains quickly and balancing speed
with operational credibility.

- Willingness to travel internationally several times a year and develop a strong working

postings.title: IAM Engineer - SSO
postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

- Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.

- Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.

- Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.

- Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.

- Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

- Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.

- Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.

- Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.

- Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.

- Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

- Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.

- Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.

- Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.

- Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

- Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.

- Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.

- Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.

- Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.

- Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

- Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.

- Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.

- Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.

- Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.

- Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

- Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.

- Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.

- Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.

- Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.

- Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.

- Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.

- Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.

- Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

- Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.

- Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.

- Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.

- Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.

- Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.

- Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.

- Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

- Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.

- Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.

- Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.

- Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.

- Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

- Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.

- Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.

- Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.

- Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.

- Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

- DTS identity and access governance standards.

- Regular access reviews and recertification.

- Privileged access governance.

- External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.

- Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.

- AI agent identity, permission and action governance.

- Dataset and sensitive data access governance.

- Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.

- Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.

- Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

- Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.

- Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.

- Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.

- Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.

- Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.

- Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.

- Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.

- Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.

You will be expected to design, build, and continuously improve automated incident management workflows that connect our toolchain Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp into a seamless, intelligent, and low friction incident response system.

Incident Automation & Toolchain Integration

- Design and implement automated incident workflows across the full toolchain: Jira, Confluence, Statuspage, Intercom, Zendesk, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp

- Build and maintain ChatOps workflows in Slack and Teams automating incident channel creation, responder assignment, status updates, and escalation triggers

- Automate Statuspage updates based on monitoring alerts and incident severity thresholds, ensuring real time public facing status communication with zero manual delay

- Configure Jira automation rules for incident ticket creation, priority routing, SLA timers, escalation triggers, and post incident task generation

- Automate customer facing communication through Intercom and Zendesk including incident acknowledgement messages, progress updates, and resolution notifications

- Build WhatsApp and Teams notification workflows for executive and stakeholder briefings during critical incidents

- Maintain and improve Confluence automation for RCA templates, incident documentation, and runbook generation triggered by incident closure

- Integrate monitoring and alerting tools (Datadog, Statuspage, PagerDuty) with the communication stack to ensure zero gap detection to notification flows

- Continuously evaluate and improve automation coverage reducing manual steps, improving response speed, and ensuring consistency across all incident communication channels

Process & Knowledge Management

- Develop, maintain, and enforce incident management playbooks, runbooks, and escalation procedures

- Build and maintain a centralized incident knowledge base in Confluence ensuring learnings from every major incident are captured and actioned

- Define and own the post incident review process including templates, timelines, and accountability tracking for preventive actions

- Identify recurring incident patterns and work proactively with engineering teams to eliminate root causes

MANAGING DIRECTOR

JOB PURPOSE

As a Managing Director at Burson Buchanan, you will be a principal growth engine, client counsellor, and key leader within our premier strategic advisory boutique. Burson Buchanan delivers high-level advisory and communications support to clients on major capital markets events, ongoing financial communications, high-profile litigation and government investigations, crises and other reputation-defining events. Backed by Burson’s global network and market-leading data, analytics and AI tools, Burson Buchanan is defining strategic communications advisory for the intelligence era.

As a business generator, you will leverage your deep network of relationships within the advisory community—including leading investment banks, law firms and other advisory firms—and in the executive ranks and boardrooms of leading companies to help originate new business leads and opportunities. As a strategic senior counsellor, you will oversee accounts and lead teams in responding to the market-shaping events faced by Burson Buchanan clients, ensuring we consistently deliver excellent client work while driving sustainable account growth and long-term client retention.

As a member of the Burson Buchanan Senior Leadership Team (SLT), you will help shape the strategic direction of the firm. Leading by example, you will set the tone for a team culture that is built on high performance, teamwork, and open and respectful feedback to continue to elevate the value we bring to clients.

CLIENT & STRATEGIC ADVISORY

- Advise and lead: serve as a trusted, high-level strategic advisor at the C-suite and Board level, delivering peer-to-peer counsel on complex capital markets activity (e.g., M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism situations) as well as high-stakes reputational issues (e.g., crisis/issues management and litigation).

- Innovate: Position Burson Buchanan as the UK’s premier strategic comms advisory by seamlessly blending deep capital markets acumen with Burson’s state-of-the-art AI technology suite. Leverage Burson’s global network to support clients across multi-jurisdictional financial and corporate communications challenges.

- Market leader: Maintain a comprehensive, forward-looking understanding of global capital markets, macroeconomic drivers, regulatory shifts, and competitive dynamics to add transformative value to client mandates.

- Client service leader: Lead complex client accounts and major transaction mandates, ensuring flawless execution, game-changing strategic positioning, and the highest standards of quality control across all deliverables.

- Lead by example: Operate with a true “player-coach” mindset—demonstrating the agility to transition seamlessly from board-level counsel to rolling up your sleeves on core deliverables, taking proactive ownership to solve both client and firm-wide challenges.

COMMERCIAL & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

- Origination & growth: act as a primary business generator for Burson Buchanan. Proactively identify, target, and convert high-value new business opportunities that advance the firm’s commercial priorities.

- Network & brand ambassador: serve as a prominent external ambassador for Burson Buchanan through market commentary, event participation, and senior industry networking to enhance agency profile and lead pipeline.

- Cross-agency opportunities: proactively identify cross-selling opportunities across the broader Burson and WPP networks, bringing multi-disciplinary capability to capital markets clients.

- Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)

- Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance

- Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]

- Position Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Engineer is responsible for embedding security directly into the design, development, testing, and operation of DTS products and platforms.

This is a hands-on security engineering role. The role requires someone who can work directly with product and engineering teams, review designs, assess APIs, run threat models, test systems, coordinate penetration testing, identify vulnerabilities, and help teams remediate issues.

The role ensures DTS products, APIs, data collaboration capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and client-facing services are designed, built, and tested securely. It also owns the practical offensive security and adversarial assurance activity needed to test DTS products from an attacker’s perspective.

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security Operations, Privacy, Cloud and Platform Security, and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure security issues are identified early, fixed effectively, and tracked through governance where required.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-on Product and Application Security

Provide hands-on security support across DTS products and engineering teams. This includes:

- Reviewing product designs, technical designs, APIs, services, and integrations.

- Identifying security weaknesses in applications, workflows, and data flows.

- Advising engineering teams on secure implementation.

- Supporting secure design decisions during product discovery and delivery.

- Helping teams resolve security issues pragmatically without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

2. Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Embed security into the software development lifecycle across DTS. This includes:

- Defining and applying secure engineering standards.

- Supporting secure coding practices.

- Reviewing CI/CD security controls.

- Supporting SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and container scanning.

- Helping teams triage, prioritise, and remediate security findings.

- Working with engineering teams to make security checks practical and repeatable.

3. Threat Modelling and Security Design Reviews

Run threat modelling and security design reviews for new and changed capabilities. This includes:

- Facilitating threat modelling sessions with engineering and product teams.

- Reviewing authentication and authorization designs.

- Assessing API exposure, data flows, trust boundaries, and abuse cases.

- Identifying risks around tenant isolation, privilege escalation, data leakage, and misuse.

- Documenting key findings, recommendations, and residual risks.

4. Offensive Security and Adversarial Testing

Carry out and coordinate offensive security testing across DTS products and platforms. This includes:

- Performing hands-on security testing of products, APIs, and workflows.

- Coordinating external penetration tests.

- Supporting red team and purple team exercises where required.

- Testing abuse cases and attacker paths.

- Testing access control, authentication, authorization, and data leakage risks.

- Validating remediation of security findings.

- Feeding material risks into the ISMS and Risk Officer for tracking.

5. API, Integration and Data Product Security

Provide security assurance for APIs, integrations, and data products. This includes:

- Reviewing externally exposed APIs and partner integrations.

- Assessing rate limiting, authorization, tenant isolation, logging, abuse prevention, and data leakage controls.

- Supporting secure integration between InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open, and third-party platforms.

- Reviewing data product workflows for misuse, excessive access, or unintended exposure.

- Working with Privacy Engineering on privacy-sensitive APIs, algorithms, and outputs.

6. AI and Agentic Security Testing

Provide hands-on security review and adversarial testing for AI-enabled and agentic capabilities. This includes:

- Testing prompt injection, tool misuse, data leakage, and excessive agency.

- Reviewing how agents access APIs, data, tools, and workflows.

- Testing whether agent permissions can be bypassed or escalated.

- Assessing action boundaries and human approval points.

- Working with Identity, AI, and Data Access Governance to validate agent access models.

- Documenting AI and agentic security risks and remediation actions.

7. Vulnerability Triage and Remediation Support

Help teams understand, prioritise, and fix security vulnerabilities. This includes:

- Reviewing vulnerability findings from scans, penetration tests, code reviews, cloud tools, and external reports.

- Prioritising findings based on exploitability, exposure, data sensitivity, and business impact.

- Working directly with engineers to define remediation options.

- Validating that fixes are effective.

- Supporting exception and risk acceptance decisions where remediation is delayed.

- Ensuring significant issues are visible through the DTS risk process.

8. Engineering Enablement and Security Coaching

Act as a practical security partner to engineering teams. This includes:

- Providing secure implementation guidance.

- Creating lightweight security patterns and examples.

- Coaching engineers on common application, API, and AI security risks.

- Helping teams understand the “why” behind security requirements.

- Supporting a culture where security is part of product quality, not a separate approval gate.

Key Accountabilities

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will be accountable for:

- Hands-on application and product security support across DTS.

- Secure SDLC guidance and practical adoption.

- Threat modelling and security design reviews.

- API, integration, and data product security reviews.

- Offensive security and adversarial testing activity.

- AI and agentic security testing.

- Vulnerability triage, remediation guidance, and fix validation.

- Coordination with ISMS/Risk to ensure material risks and exceptions are tracked.

- Helping engineering teams build secure systems without unnecessary delivery drag.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:

- Strong hands-on experience in application security, product security, offensive security, security engineering, or penetration testing.

- Good understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, SaaS platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.

- Experience with threat modelling and secure design reviews.

- Practical knowledge of common application and API security risks, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, injection, data leakage, privilege escalation, and supply chain risk.

- Experience using security testing tools and techniques across web applications, APIs, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management workflows.

- Experience working directly with engineers to remediate findings.

- Understanding of AI and agentic security risks would be highly valuable.

- Ability to communicate clearly with engineering, product, architecture, security, and leadership stakeholders.

- A pragmatic, delivery-aware approach to security.

Leadership Expectations

The Product, Application and Offensive Security Engineer is expected to:

- Be hands-on and technically credible with engineering teams.

- Act as a trusted security partner, not just a reviewer or approver.

- Challenge insecure designs constructively.

- Help teams find practical ways to reduce risk.

- Prioritise issues based on real-world exploitability and business impact.

- Work across multiple DTS product areas without becoming a delivery bottleneck.

- Escalate material risks clearly through the appropriate governance routes.

- Promote secure engineering habits through practical guidance and example.

Success Measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

- Security being embedded earlier in product and engineering delivery.

- Reduction in high-risk application, API, and product vulnerabilities.

- Regular threat modelling and security reviews for critical DTS capabilities.

- Effective offensive and adversarial testing of products, APIs, and workflows.

- Faster remediation of penetration test and security testing findings.

- Improved security assurance for AI and agentic workflows.

- Engineering teams receiving practical, actionable security guidance.

- Material security risks being surfaced and tracked through the DTS risk process.

- Security being viewed by engineering teams as an enabler of trusted delivery rather than a blocker.

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational platform infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With operations across the US and UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure supports globally distributed services across our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

We are seeking a skilled Platform Engineer to design, build, evolve, and optimize our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes. You will work closely with software engineers, QA, IT, and product teams to streamline development workflows, improve system reliability, and ensure our infrastructure is secure and scalable.

- Design scalable, cloud-native systems on platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform to support high-throughput applications and services.

- Build secure, multi-account and cross-cloud environments.

- Optimize cost efficiency for high-scale workloads and low-latency microservices.

- Improve visibility into performance and cost metrics across environments and workloads.

- Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters for containerized applications and microservices.

- Implement blue/green and canary deployment strategies.

- Build robust automation using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Argo Workflows.

- Automate testing, security scans, and compliance checks.

- Support colleagues in making architectural choices about cloud services.

- Promote a small, coherent, and flexible configuration surface to reduce deployment time and improve release confidence.

- Champion DRY and DevOps principles through code reviews, documentation, and shared tooling.

- 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in enterprise-scale environments.

- Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.

- Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code using HashiCorp tools or equivalent.

- Deep experience containerizing and orchestrating applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

- Solid scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar, with an automation-first mindset.

- Golang knowledge is a plus.

- Experience implementing observability and monitoring solutions such as Datadog, Prometheus, or the Elastic Stack.

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a strong plus.

- Ability to define and document clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable product insights.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and vice-versa.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.

Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.

We're looking for a Programme Lead (Value & Delivery) to help ensure those investments translate into measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the heart of WPP's Enterprise AI programme, owning the critical link between delivery and impact. While delivery teams focus on building AI solutions, you'll focus on proving and maximising their value, ensuring solutions become embedded into the way people work and that benefits are measured, evidenced and sustained over time.

You'll work with senior business stakeholders and functional leaders to shape investment decisions, drive adoption at scale and ensure WPP realises the full value of its AI ambitions.

What you'll be doing:

- Own value realisation for WPP's Enterprise AI portfolio, ensuring investments deliver measurable business outcomes and demonstrable return on investment.

- Develop and maintain business cases, benefits frameworks, adoption metrics and executive reporting for senior Technology and Transformation stakeholders.

- Take accountability for the successful adoption and long-term sustainability of AI solutions after go-live.

- Lead the transition of the Enterprise AI opportunity pipeline into permanent in-house ownership, qualifying and prioritising demand before it enters delivery.

- Own the enterprise-wide adoption and measurement framework, establishing baselines, KPIs, benchmarks and reporting standards across multiple business environments.

- Lead the WPP Frontier Lab, evaluating emerging AI products and translating market developments into practical business recommendations.

- Manage the AI Hub demand funnel and agent registry, ensuring opportunities are prioritised effectively and existing capabilities are leveraged before new solutions are created.

- Define and implement the operating model for Enterprise AI, helping establish what business-as-usual looks like as AI scales across WPP.

- Represent AI adoption, value realisation and programme outcomes at steering committees, programme boards and senior leadership forums.

- Lead and develop a small specialist team focused on value tracking, adoption measurement and operational excellence.

- Partner closely with delivery, governance and business stakeholders to ensure a consistent, evidence-led approach to Enterprise AI.

What we are looking for:

- Significant experience leading enterprise transformation, value realisation, programme delivery or business change initiatives within large global organisations.

- A proven track record of owning business cases, benefits frameworks and post-implementation value measurement.

- Experience transitioning programmes from outsourced or partner-led delivery into sustainable in-house ownership.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to build, challenge and defend investment cases.

- Experience working directly with senior stakeholders across functions such as Finance, Shared Services, Tax or Transformation.

- The ability to influence at senior levels while remaining equally effective with operational teams.

- Excellent analytical capability and the confidence to challenge assumptions, methodologies and reported outcomes.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready materials and recommendations.

- Experience leading distributed teams and operating across complex stakeholder environments.

Nice to have

- Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft 365 adoption or enterprise-scale AI programmes.

- Familiarity with Viva Insights, Power BI and adoption analytics.

- Background in finance, audit, controls or business performance measurement.

- Experience working within media, advertising, marketing services or similarly complex global businesses.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

postings.description:

Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Automation Quality Analyst specialising in Playwright to join our quality assurance team. As an Automation QA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by designing and maintaining automated test coverage, executing test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating with development teams to resolve issues. You will help sustain the reliability of our platform under a trunk-based, continuously delivered way of working. Your work will help us deliver exceptional user experiences and maintain high standards of product excellence. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Automation Quality Analyst, you will:

- Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable test cases and automation coverage.

- Develop, document and execute detailed test plans and test cases.

- Design and automate end-to-end tests using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Implement and maintain test automation frameworks.

- Execute automated and manual test cases, and perform both formal and exploratory testing.

- Conduct regression testing to verify that resolved issues do not affect existing functionality.

- Identify, document and track defects using bug tracking tools, providing clear and concise descriptions of issues.

- Review test cases and automated tests written by other QA engineers.

- Embed automated tests within the CI/CD pipeline, keeping merge-gate and nightly regression suites reliable.

- Investigate and address test flakiness to maintain confidence in automated results.

- Participate in design and requirement reviews, providing input on testability and quality risks.

- Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues.

- Work with the DevOps and SRE teams to ensure test environments and test data are stable and available.

- Lead testing activities during sprint and release cycles.

- Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical teams, and report test results to stakeholders.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies.

- Stay up to date with industry trends and best practice in software testing and test automation.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every single skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you possess a strong foundation in automation QA and a willingness to learn and grow.

- 3–5 years' proven experience as a QA engineer or in a similar role, including hands-on test automation.

- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools and processes, and of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

- Experience testing complex web applications.

- Hands-on knowledge of Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Experience implementing and maintaining test automation frameworks.

- Knowledge of CI/CD tooling, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

- Knowledge and experience of API testing (Postman or any other similar tool).

- Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail).

- Ability to lead testing activities during sprint and release.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, detail-oriented with a keen eye for identifying issues and inconsistencies.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field is preferred.

Desirable experience

- Experience working in a trunk-based development and continuous delivery environment.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tooling.

- Familiarity with basic SQL queries for database validation.

- Exposure to performance testing concepts.

- Experience stabilising large end-to-end regression suites and reducing automation debt.

We are looking to hire an individual that will own the identification, assessment, documentation and monitoring of digital and information security risks across WPP, ensuring risks are clearly articulated, consistently assessed and effectively tracked.

Risk Assessment & Management

- Conduct enterprise and operational security risk assessments.

- Ensure risk statements, impact and likelihood justifications are clear and defensible.

- Maintain accurate and current risk records within approved GRC tooling.

Risk Management

- Conduct organisational-level, third-party or product risk assessments to identify technical, process and/or procedural vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.

- Support the implementation of WPP’s Digital Security risk management framework, ensuring alignment with organisational goals.

- Monitor and report on Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to provide insights into WPP’s cybersecurity posture.

Risk Treatment & Monitoring

- Support risk owners in defining proportionate mitigation actions.

- Track remediation progress and reassess residual risk.

- Escalate material risk changes or overdue actions.

What you'll need:

Essential:

- Fluent English (reading, writing, and conversation).

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Risk Management, or equivalent

- Experience in cybersecurity governance, GRC, or risk support roles.

- Strong understanding of cybersecurity policies, standards, and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001, NIST CSF).

- Ability to work with governance, assurance, and technical teams to maintain clear and usable frameworks.

- Strong written communication skills, with high attention to accuracy and consistency.

- Foundational understanding of cloud computing models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and associated security risks.

- Awareness of common cyber risk scenarios related to cloud platforms, SaaS environments, identity, and third-party integrations.

- Exposure to emerging technology risks, such as AI-enabled systems, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.

- Ability to assess risks across modern, distributed technology environments.

- Foundational understanding of DevSecOps principles and secure-by-design approaches within modern software development lifecycles.

- Ability to elevate the role to value-driven cyber risk management

Nice - to- have

- Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC.

- Familiarity with GRC tools and risk management platforms.

- Working knowledge of agile methodologies.

- Experience in multinational, multicultural and matrixed companies.

- Proactive Problem-Solving: Anticipates challenges in governance and compliance activities and develops effective solutions.

- Collaborative: Builds strong relationships across teams (e.g., Legal, Enterprise Technology) to ensure alignment and efficiency.

- Detail-Oriented: Ensures accuracy and consistency in governance documentation, role definitions, and standards.

- Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and adjusts quickly to changing priorities or regulatory requirements.

- Ethical Integrity: Maintains high ethical standards, ensuring compliance with policies and safeguarding WPP’s reputation.

- Analytical Thinking: Demonstrates strong analytical skills to interpret complex data and identify actionable insights.

- Communication Skills: Clearly articulates findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Structured & Methodical: Applies a disciplined approach to governance maintenance and change control.

- Collaborative: Works effectively with Strategy & Risk, TSG, Assurance, and Legal to support the governance lifecycle.

postings.description:
