Role Purpose:

WPP is undergoing an exciting global transformation, and we are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Automation Quality Analyst, specialising in Playwright, to join our Central QA team. In this senior role you will lead the automation of our regression and end-to-end test suites, set the standard for test quality across the team, and act as a go-to technical reference for other QA engineers.You will be instrumental in sustaining the reliability of our platform under a trunk-based, continuously delivered way of working, where quality has to be built in early rather than inspected at the end. Beyond strong automation fundamentals, we are looking for someone attuned to modern, AI-assisted ways of working — using AI tooling to accelerate test design, authoring and analysis without compromising rigour. This is a senior position with a clear path towards a QA Lead role for the right person. We encourage applications from a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Senior Automation Quality Analyst, you will:

Automation and test engineering

- Lead the design, build and maintenance of automated end-to-end and regression suites using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript.

- Analyse business requirements and translate them into robust, maintainable test cases and automation coverage.

- Perform formal and exploratory testing; execute and review both automated and manual test cases.

- Identify, document and track defects, providing clear and concise descriptions that allow developers to reproduce and resolve issues efficiently.

- Conduct regression testing to verify that resolved issues do not affect existing functionality.

Continuous delivery and the merge gate

- Embed testing into the CI/CD pipeline, keeping the merge gate reliable and the nightly regression green.

- Use AI tooling to accelerate test authoring, data creation and defect analysis, applying sound judgement to validate AI-assisted output.

- Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues, and with SRE and DevOps to keep test environments and test data stable.

- Lead testing activities during sprints and releases.

- Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, and report test results.

- Define and apply the criteria for what belongs in the merge gate versus the nightly suite, keeping gate suites within an agreed time budget so they give fast, trustworthy feedback.

- Own test stability — triage flaky tests, apply the quarantine policy, and drive fixes so confidence in automated results is maintained.

- Design test coverage appropriate to each environment as code progresses from integration through to pre-production and performance environments.

- Provide test evidence to support release readiness and the Go/No-Go decision.

Standards, mentoring and hand-over

- Set and uphold automation standards; review other engineers' test cases and automated tests and mentor QA engineers on good practice.

- Stabilise test suites and hand them over to POD teams, supporting developers in maintaining them once ownership transfers.

- Work across multiple POD teams and codebases, adapting to differing priorities while keeping a consistent quality bar.

- Participate in design and requirement reviews, providing input on testability and quality risks.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and methodologies, and keep current with industry trends and best practice.

Collaboration and communication

- Use AI tooling to accelerate test authoring, data creation and defect analysis, applying sound judgement to validate AI-assisted output.

- Collaborate with developers to identify the root cause of issues, and with SRE and DevOps to keep test environments and test data stable.

- Lead testing activities during sprints and releases.

- Communicate complex issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, and report test results.

- Support investigation of production incidents where test coverage or quality is a contributing factor.

Skill Requirements:

We understand that candidates may not have every skill listed below. We encourage you to apply if you have a strong automation foundation and the drive to lead and grow.

- 6–8 years' proven experience as an automation QA or test engineer, with a track record of owning automation on complex web applications.

- Strong, hands-on expertise in Playwright with TypeScript — designing and maintaining automation frameworks from the ground up.

- Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, tools and processes, of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and of trunk-based and continuous delivery workflows.

- Proficiency with GitHub and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI) to run tests as part of the pipeline.

- Experience with API testing (Postman or similar).

- Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. Jira, TestRail).

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing — practical use of AI tooling to improve the speed and quality of QA work.

- Proven ability to lead testing activities during sprint and release, and to mentor other QA engineers.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for identifying issues and inconsistencies.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities across teams in a fast-paced environment.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field is preferred.

Desirable experience

- Experience stabilizing large end-to-end regression suites and driving down automation debt.

- Exposure to performance testing concepts and reliability engineering practices.

- Familiarity with basic SQL queries for database validation.

- Exposure to working with Python.

We are seeking a technically minded product leader to define what WPP's agents are actually able to do. This is a new role, created to own the layer beneath the interface: the core set of skills and tools that agents call, the guardrails that keep them safe to use, the data and context they reason over, and the agentification of WPP's own applications so that they can be operated by an agent and not only by a person.

The ideal candidate will have taken an established product and made it agent-native — exposing its capabilities as tools, skills and data an agent can call, defining the contracts, permissions and behaviour around them, and proving the result is reliable to put in front of enterprise customers. Skills, tools and agentification are not new in the industry, and we are looking for someone who has already done this work somewhere it mattered.

This is a more technical product role in the Agentic Experience pillar and sits at the intersection of product and AI. You may come from product management, engineering or data science. What matters is that you can hold a clear point of view on where a capability belongs — in the model, in a tool, in the data, or in the interface — and defend it with evidence.

It is also a visionary / forward-looking role in the pillar. A good deal of what you will own does not exist yet, and part of the job is deciding what should. This requires a product leader who is comfortable with ambiguity but still ships, and who can bring a large organisation along with them.

What You Will Do:

Within this IC role, reporting into the Senior Director Product Enablement WPP Open – you will:

- Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for skills, tools and agentification across WPP Open, ensuring alignment with the broader Open strategy and business objectives.

- Define the core set of skills that WPP's agents are built from — what exists as a first-party skill, what is left to users to compose, and what should not be a skill at all.

- Own the tool layer: how WPP and third-party capabilities are exposed to agents through well-defined interfaces, contracts, permissions and connectivity standards such as MCP.

- Lead the agentification of WPP applications, working with the teams that own them to make their capabilities callable, observable and safe to operate agentically.

- Define the guardrails (what an agent may do, on whose authority, with what data), working with Agent Governance so they are built into the product.

- Own the evaluation and quality approach for skills and for chained agent output: how capability is tested before release and monitored after it.

- Define the data and context strategy that agents reason over, spanning retrieval, grounding, memory, context management and the interfaces to WPP's data and knowledge assets.

- Work closely with Engineering, Design, UX and Data to deliver a coherent skills layer. Set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.

- Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.

- Use data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from stakeholders and systems to enhance product adoption and usage continually.

- Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients, and make an unfamiliar technical area legible to senior stakeholders so that new capabilities are understood and adopted, and their benefits championed.

- Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, engineering leadership or applied data science, with significant time spent on AI or platform products.

- Proven track record of taking an established SaaS or enterprise product and making it agent-native.

- Deep and current knowledge of agent architectures: LLMs, tool, skill and function calling, RAG and retrieval design, context & memory management, multi-agent orchestration, and connectivity standards such as MCP.

- Direct experience with working with agent and tooling ecosystems such as MCP/A2A servers and clients, LangChain or LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or comparable skill and tool frameworks.

- Experience defining guardrails, permissions and safety controls for autonomous or semi-autonomous systems and making them part of the product.

- Experience with evaluation of non-deterministic systems: test sets, scoring rubrics, regression testing, human review and production monitoring.

- Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability, with the ability to hold a credible technical conversation with senior engineers.

- Experience with data and knowledge platforms — retrieval, embeddings, semantic search, taxonomy and grounding against enterprise content.

Senior Technology Risk Analyst

- Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)

- Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance

- Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]

- Position Type: Full-Time

Role Purpose

The Senior Technology Risk Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation

- Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.

- Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.

- Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.

- Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.

- Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.

- Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance

- Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.

- Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.

- Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.

- Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.

- Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation

- Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board.

- Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.

- Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.

- Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.

- Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.

- Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management

- Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.

- Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.

- Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.

- Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.

- Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.

- Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management

- Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.

- Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.

- Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.

- Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness

- Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).

- Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.

- Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.

- Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking

- Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.

- Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.

- Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support

- Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.

- Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.

- Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting

- Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.

- Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture

- Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.

- Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.

- Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

- Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.

- Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.

- Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.

- Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.

- Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Required:

- Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation.

- Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.

- Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.

- Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation. Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

- Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 

- Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 

- Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 

- Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

- Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

- Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work.

- Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 

- In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 

- Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 

- Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively.

- Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery.

- Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback.

- Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 

- Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 

- Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 

- Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain.

- Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization.

- Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation.

- Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data.

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a Technical Security Governance Lead – Exposure Management to help build, mature, and govern a modern exposure management capability across our global environment.

This role focuses on understanding how attackers see us—across external, internal, and AI-enabled environments—and ensuring the organization continuously validates, prioritizes, and reduces real-world attack opportunities.

This is a highly strategic, lead-level role for someone who understands modern attack paths and wants to shape how security is measured and improved. You will move beyond theoretical risk into practical attacker realism—governing the adversarial testing programs, attack surface visibility, exploitability validation, and attack path analysis that keep WPP secure.

What you'll be doing:

Technical Security & Exposure Governance

- Define and shape the governance framework, guardrails, and minimum standards for continuous exposure management across WPP.

- Drive continuous improvement in attack surface visibility, control effectiveness, and risk-driven exposure governance.

- Establish escalation thresholds for validated exploitable paths and constructively challenge delayed remediations.

Adversarial Assurance Governance

- Oversee and govern continuous adversarial testing and offensive validation programs across infrastructure, applications, APIs, cloud, and identity.

- Partner with and govern specialist external providers to validate real-world exploitability and attack paths.

- Help internal teams understand where technical weaknesses translate into realistic attack opportunities.

AI Adversarial Testing Governance

- Shape and govern the adversarial testing approaches for AI and agentic systems, a rapidly growing and critical domain for WPP.

- Support and oversee testing for modern AI risks, including prompt injection resilience, tool misuse, data leakage scenarios, and agent permission boundaries.

- Collaborate with product and AI teams to mature security controls and drive safer AI adoption.

- 日々のクライアント担当者やシニアステークホルダーと、信頼に基づいた強固な関係を構築・維持する。

- 効果的かつ効率的にチーム運営を行うことができる。

- Excellent communication and presentation skills.

- Bachelor's degree or above.

- Business level English proficiency (preferred).

- Effectively communicates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

- In collaboration with strategists and connection planners, define the consumer journey, the role of each funnel and channel, and key connection points to lead the development of the overall communication plan.

- Partner with creative teams to drive the creation of impactful and innovative ideas.

- Champion excellent creative ideas and guide their execution to the highest standard at every touchpoint.

- Help create an environment where bold ideas can flourish.

- Client Management and External Parties

- Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with day-to-day clients and senior stakeholders.

- Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand, and internal processes to exceed their expectations.

- Liaise with media partners and other external collaborators to orchestrate a single, comprehensive experience and ensure seamless campaign implementation.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

The Role

You will be a key social and influencer strategist.

A strategist who lives inside platforms, reads culture in real time, and translates signals into ideas that move both the brand and the business.

You will shape social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and integrated campaigns across Instagram, X, TikTok, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms. You will connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive ecosystem while ensuring strategies remain insight-led, platform-native and aligned with broader business and marketing objectives.

You will work closely with clients, creative, production, media, analytics and external partners to translate strategy into execution, ensuring every piece of work delivers measurable business impact.

You will use social tools, AI, and data to build smarter workflows, stronger insights and faster delivery.

This role suits someone who is strategic, hands-on, commercially minded and passionate about helping brands grow through social and influencer marketing. You will be expected to take ownership of strategic workstreams and lead projects from strategy through execution, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across the business. Someone who thrives in ambiguity, simplifies complexity and consistently raises the quality of work around them.

You work well with people, and you work well on your own.

You think. You do. You deliver.

Key Responsibilities

Social Strategy

- Lead the development of integrated social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and campaigns aligned with business and brand objectives.

- Contribute to quarterly and annual strategic planning in partnership with clients and internal teams.

- Define the role of each social platform across Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging channels.

- Connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive strategy.

- Translate business challenges, consumer insights and cultural trends into clear strategic direction and actionable creative briefs.

- Ensure strategic consistency across platforms while enabling culturally relevant and platform-native executions.

- Use AI and social intelligence tools to sharpen insights, uncover opportunities and accelerate delivery.

Influencer Strategy & Partnerships

- Develop influencer activation strategies that align with the overall social strategy.

- Define creator roles, content territories, platform mix and activation approaches for each campaign.

- Develop creator selection criteria balancing audience relevance, credibility, reach and engagement.

- Partner closely with influencer agencies, creator platforms and external partners to ensure strategic alignment and execution quality.

- Develop influencer briefing principles, content guardrails and approval workflows that protect brand quality and consistency.

- Identify opportunities for social-first innovation, emerging creators, new platforms and strategic partnerships.

- Evaluate influencer performance and provide recommendations to strengthen future creator programs.

Performance, Data & Optimization

- Build KPI frameworks for both organic and paid activity.

- Develop measurement plans and learning agendas for campaigns.

- Track performance through weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reporting.

- Partner with analytics teams to interpret brand and campaign performance.

- Present actionable insights, performance reviews and optimization recommendations to clients.

- Use social listening, trend analysis, AI and audience data to guide content and strategic decisions.

- Turn insights into practical recommendations that improve future performance.

Creative & Production Collaboration

- Translate approved strategies into clear, inspiring creative briefs.

- Partner with creative teams to shape platform-native ideas and content systems.

- Guide storytelling, content formats, creator partnerships and channel recommendations.

- Brief copywriters, designers, creators and production teams to ensure alignment with the strategic intent.

- Provide strategic guidance throughout content production and campaign development to maintain alignment with business objectives and platform best practices.

- Review creative output and ensure deliverables meet both strategic and creative expectations before client presentation.

Client & Cross-functional Collaboration

- Serve as a trusted social and influencer strategy partner for clients throughout the lifecycle of a project.

- Lead strategic discussions within projects and confidently present recommendations, insights and future opportunities to clients.

- Share platform updates, cultural trends, thought leadership and best practices with clients and internal teams.

- Work collaboratively across account, creative, media, production, analytics and research teams to deliver integrated solutions.

- Support regional and global initiatives by adapting global strategies into locally relevant execution.

- Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration across markets.

- Take ownership of the strategic workstream from briefing through optimization while ensuring alignment across all project stakeholders.

What You Bring

Experience

- 8–10+ years of experience in social strategy, influencer strategy or integrated digital marketing.

- Proven experience developing and delivering social and influencer strategies for major brands.

- Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms.

- Experience working across organic, paid, owned and earned media.

- Experience collaborating with creative, production, media and analytics teams throughout campaign development.

- Experience working with regional or global stakeholders is highly desirable.

- Strong client presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

Craft

- Fluent in consumer insight, social strategy and content planning.

- Strong understanding of influencer ecosystems and creator marketing.

- Able to build strategic frameworks that connect business objectives to creative execution.

- Skilled in social listening, trend analysis and performance measurement.

- Strong at translating data into actionable business recommendations.

- Comfortable using AI tools, prompt engineering, and automation to improve efficiency and quality.

Mindset

- Curious, commercially minded and solutions-oriented.

- Thinks strategically while remaining highly hands-on.

- Comfortable switching between long-term planning and day-to-day execution.

- Confident working across cross-functional teams and leading projects in fast-paced environments.

- Collaborative, proactive and accountable.

- Passionate about growing clients' businesses and strengthening the Content Studio's strategic capability.

Language Requirements

- Professional proficiency in both Japanese and English.

#LI-DNP

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. For more information, visit WPP.com.

The Role 

You are a hands-on strategist who can turn a brand problem into social work people would choose to spend time with. You find the audience behavior that matters, give social a clear job and build a plan the team can make. 

You own strategy workstreams across client brands, from always-on content to campaigns and creator work. You work with the Social Strategy Lead and with creative, account, media, production and analytics teams. You lead client conversations on your assignments and help junior strategists improve through direct feedback. 

You know the platforms from the inside, but you can also zoom out to the brand idea and the wider customer journey. You understand how organic content and paid social move people from discovery to action, and can explain why a plan should perform. 

What You Will Lead 

Social Strategy and Planning 

- Turn business and brand briefs into audience insight, a clear social role and useful creative briefs.

- Build always-on and campaign plans with distinct jobs for channels such as Instagram (Meta), TikTok, X, LINE and YouTube, where relevant.

- Give organic, paid, owned and earned work distinct roles across the funnel, with creators and communities where they serve the idea.

- Stay involved from strategy through content planning and production so the idea survives execution.

Performance, Data, and AI 

- Use social listening, platform data and client research to find opportunities and test assumptions.

- Lead paid social planning for your assignments: objectives, audiences, placements, budget split, creative variants and test design.

- Work with media and analytics teams to read performance, improve creative and targeting, and make clear recommendations on spend.

- Set KPIs for each stage of the funnel, with a baseline and a learning goal. Know when reach, engagement, traffic, conversion or cost per result matters.

- Build agentic workflows with AI and WPP.open that turn client briefs, audience signals and performance data into strategic choices, then carry those choices into creative briefs, channel plans, content guidance and next tests, with human review.

Content and Channels 

- Partner with creatives to shape platform-native ideas, hooks and formats that work in feeds and paid placements.

- Write channel guidance and examples that make the strategy useful to creators and production teams.

- Apply a current understanding of Japanese audience behavior and platform conventions.

- Define the role of creators and influencers in the plan and how their contribution will be judged.

Client Leadership and Teamwork 

- Lead the strategy and paid social planning workstream for assigned projects, present your thinking and handle client feedback clearly.

- Work with account, creative, media, creator and analytics partners to make one coherent plan.

- Mentor junior strategists through briefs, reviews and specific feedback on their work.

- Keep decisions, deadlines and handovers clear when several projects are moving at once.

What You Bring 

Experience 

- Strong social strategy experience across brands, with independent ownership of campaigns or always-on programs.

- Work that shows the path from insight and brief to live content and what it achieved.

- Experience leading paid social and performance marketing plans, with a working knowledge of how campaigns are set up, bought, optimized and measured across the funnel.

- Working knowledge of major social platforms in Japan, organic social and creator partnerships.

- Ability to connect brand strategy and the wider customer journey to the work social can do best.

- Confidence presenting recommendations to clients and working across disciplines.

Craft 

- Sharp at finding the useful insight, writing a single-minded brief and making a clear deck.

- Able to guide content ideas without flattening what makes them native to a platform.

- Comfortable with listening, analytics and paid platform results, and able to turn a report into the next action.

- An instinct for building useful agentic workflows, with the judgment to check and improve their output.

Mindset 

- Close to social culture without chasing every trend.

- Collaborative, practical and open to challenge.

- Calm under pressure and comfortable moving between strategy and detail.

- Generous with junior teammates and accountable for your own work.

Language Requirements 

Able to work effectively with Japanese and English-speaking teams and clients.

Purpose:

The Social Strategy Lead plays a senior leadership role across social strategy and intelligence within WPP Content Studio Japan.

This person helps shape how social is understood, planned, measured, and evolved across Content Studio clients, including BAT, Nestle, and future WPP Japan clients.

This is not an executional planner role, but a leadership role for someone who can set direction, read culture, interpret platform signals, guide strategy teams, and help clients understand what brands should do on social and why.

The role sits at the intersection of social strategy, culture, data, platform behavior, creator ecosystems, AI-enabled workflows, and measurable business impact.

The Social Strategy Lead works closely with the Content Studio Lead, who owns business and account leadership. Together, they ensure the studio delivers work that is strategically sharp, creatively strong, operationally realistic, and commercially valuable.

What Success Looks Like

- WPP Content Studio Japan has a clear, credible, and differentiated social POV.

- Every client has a clear social strategy across always-on, campaign, creator, paid, organic, owned, and earned.

- Social listening and performance data turn into real creative and business decisions.

- Teams stop reacting to trends blindly and start using signals intelligently.

- Clients see WPP Content Studio as a senior social strategy partner, not just a content delivery team.

- AI and WPP.open become practical tools inside strategy, insight, ideation, reporting, and learning loops.

- Social work becomes more platform-native, culturally relevant, measurable, and easier to scale.

Key Responsibilities

- Social Strategy Leadership

- Lead social strategy initiatives across key WPP Content Studio Japan clients.

- Set clear platform roles across Meta, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, emerging channels, and client-specific ecosystems.

- Connect organic, paid, owned, earned, creator, and community activity into one clear strategic system.

- Translate business goals into social priorities, content principles, channel roles, and measurement frameworks.

- Ensure always-on and campaign work ladder up to a clear brand and business objective.

- Act as the senior social strategy POV across key client conversations and internal decision-making.

- Social Intelligence, Culture, and Listening

- Lead the studio’s social intelligence and listening capability.

- Turn social signals into actionable insight, not trend noise.

- Oversee how teams read audience behavior, platform shifts, category conversations, creator movements, and cultural tensions.

- Build repeatable intelligence outputs for clients and internal teams.

- Use social data to identify opportunity spaces, risk areas, content territories, creator angles, and community behaviors.

- Ensure Japan-first cultural nuance is embedded into social strategy, especially for regulated or sensitive categories.

- Platform and Content Direction

- Guide teams on what works natively across different platforms and why.

- Define format strategy by platform, audience, behavior, and objective.

- Shape recommendations around hooks, storytelling, creator formats, community mechanics, captions, social commerce, search behavior, and shareability.

- Partner with creative teams to push ideas beyond generic calendars and campaign cut-downs.

- Ensure content is designed for the feed, the algorithm, the audience, and the brand.

- Creator and Community Strategy

- Define the strategic role of creators across client work.

- Guide creator archetypes, casting logic, briefing angles, collaboration models, and success metrics.

- Partner with casting, PR, media, and account teams to ensure creator work is more than talent selection.

- Build community-aware thinking into social plans, including conversation drivers, UGC mechanics, participation loops, and earned potential.

- Help clients understand when to use creators, when not to, and how to measure value beyond reach.

- Measurement, Reporting, and PDCA

- Define KPI frameworks across organic, paid, creator, campaign, and always-on content.

- Ensure reporting answers what worked, what failed, why, and what to do next.

- Partner with analytics and media teams to connect performance data with creative decisions.

- Establish learning loops that improve briefs, formats, creative rules, posting rhythm, and content investment.

- Push the studio away from passive reporting and toward active optimization.

- AI and WPP.open Enablement

- Use AI and WPP.open to improve strategy quality, speed, and scale.

- Help design AI-enabled workflows for insight mining, persona development, content territory building, platform adaptation, reporting, and post-campaign learning.

- Partner with the Chief Content Architect to codify useful agentic workflows.

- Set clear human review points so AI supports judgment but does not replace it.

- Help strategy teams build better prompts, better frameworks, and better decision systems.

- Client and Stakeholder Leadership

- Join senior client conversations as the social strategy lead.

- Present social POVs clearly and confidently to clients, regional teams, and internal leadership.

- Help clients navigate platform changes without hype or panic.

- Translate complex social behavior into simple business-facing recommendations.

- Support new business and organic growth by showing how WPP Content Studio can lead modern social thinking.

- Team Leadership and Standards

- The Social Strategy Lead works closely with strategy and planning talent across WPP Content Studio Japan to elevate strategic quality and collaboration.

- This includes close collaboration with social strategists, content planners, social analysts, and related strategic roles across client teams.

- The role is responsible for setting the standard of strategic thinking across the studio, ensuring that every planner and strategist works from a shared understanding of social behavior, platform roles, audience insight, creator ecosystems, and performance learning.

- The Social Strategy Lead is accountable for developing the strategy team’s capability, reviewing strategic outputs, mentoring talent, and ensuring planners and strategists are proactive, culturally sharp, data-aware, and able to guide both clients and creative teams with confidence.

- Create clear ways of working between strategy, creative, media, analytics, account, and production teams.

- Build a culture of curiosity, speed, accountability, and practical excellence.

What This Role Is Not

- Not a community manager.

- Not a content calendar operator.

- Not just a trend hunter.

- Not a reporting-only role.

- Not responsible for running the business alone.

- Not the person who fixes every executional issue.

This person sets the social direction and ensures the studio acts intelligently.

Skills and Experience Required

- +5 tears of strong senior experience in social, digital or content strategy, or platform-led brand strategy.

- Proven ability to lead strategy across multiple brands or business units.

- Deep understanding of Japan social behavior and major platforms.

- Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, creator ecosystems, paid/organic dynamics, and emerging formats.

- Hands-on experience with social listening, performance reporting, audience insight, and cultural analysis.

- Ability to connect data, culture, platform behavior, brand goals, and creative ideas.

- Confident client-facing presence with senior stakeholders.

- Experience leading or mentoring strategy, planning, intelligence, or content teams.

- Comfortable using AI tools, prompt systems, WPP.open, and automation to strengthen strategy work.

- Strong deck, storytelling, presentation, and simplification skills.

Personal Attributes

- Clear, calm, and decisive.

- Culturally curious and platform-native.

- Strategic but practical.

- Strong enough to challenge weak thinking.

- Collaborative without being passive.

- Comfortable leading through influence.

- Able to simplify complexity for clients and teams.

- Obsessed with making the work sharper, not just faster.

Language Skills

- Japanese: Business fluent or native-level preferred.

- English: Business fluent.

- Must be comfortable presenting and writing across both Japanese and English working environments.

We’re looking for a VP, Strategic Data Science to lead the strategic data-science capability within our Open Intelligence Solutions (OIS) domain.

You’ll sit at the intersection of data science, product, clients and commercial strategy, turning complex data and business challenges into advanced modelling approaches, actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.

You’ll shape how we use data science to understand audiences and consumer behaviour, improve measurement and forecasting, automate consumer research, generate insight and develop synthetic populations and panels.

This is not a role focused solely on technical delivery. You’ll be a senior strategic partner to clients and internal stakeholders, helping define what we should build, why it matters and how data science can create measurable business value.

- Own the vision, strategy and operating model for data science across domain intelligence solutions.

- Set best practices and standards for how advanced analytics supports client, product and commercial priorities.

- Lead the development of audience definition, segmentation and behavioural modelling approaches.

- Translate complex data into actionable audience and consumer intelligence.

- Turn client needs and commercial opportunities into clear modelling roadmaps, analytical frameworks and reusable solutions.

Drive measurement, forecasting and insight

- Establish best practices across measurement, media effectiveness and insight generation.

- Lead forecasting and predictive analytics across audience, consumer and media intelligence use cases.

- Develop and scale consumer-research automation approaches that increase the speed, consistency and depth of insight.

- Lead the development of synthetic populations and synthetic panels, ensuring methodologies are credible, interpretable and commercially useful.

- Act as a senior client and stakeholder partner, shaping solutions that have clear commercial relevance.

- Work closely with Product, Commercial, Consumer Research, Measurement, Forecasting, Audience Strategy and Applied Data Science teams.

- Provide strategic direction across flagship data-science initiatives.

- Lead and develop senior applied data scientists working across audience and segmentation modelling, consumer and media intelligence, forecasting, predictive analytics, synthetic populations and panels, and media effectiveness.

- Set quality standards that ensure our work is rigorous, scalable, reusable and commercially valuable.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for an experienced data-science leader who can operate comfortably between strategy, technology and commercial delivery.

You’ll bring:

- Significant experience leading data science, advanced analytics or applied data-science teams.

- Strong expertise in areas such as audience modelling, segmentation, behavioural modelling, forecasting, predictive analytics, measurement or consumer intelligence.

- Deep understanding of media, marketing and/or advertising, with the ability to apply data science to real-world commercial challenges.

- Experience translating complex client or business problems into practical analytical solutions.

- A track record of developing methodologies, frameworks or analytical products that can be scaled and reused.

- Strong understanding of measurement and media effectiveness.

- Experience working with senior clients and stakeholders and communicating complex technical concepts in a clear, commercially relevant way.

- Ensure analytical claims are supported by robust experimental, causal and econometric evidence.

- Act as the organisation’s authority on numerical quality, measurement credibility and analytical validity.

- Challenge weak assumptions, over-claims and methodological risks before outputs reach senior stakeholders or clients.

Shape the future of measurement

- Lead the evolution of MMM and econometric measurement capabilities, ensuring approaches are robust, interpretable and aligned to commercial decision-making.

- Develop frameworks and practical guidance for attribution, causal inference, experimental design and incrementality.

- Establish best practices around model diagnostics, sensitivity testing and evidence thresholds.

- Lead and develop Senior Measurement Scientists and Statistical Specialists across areas including econometrics, MMM, experimental design, incrementality, attribution, causal inference, statistical QA and validation.

- Build statistical education and capability programmes that raise the standard of analytical thinking across the organisation.

- Help develop responsible AI-assisted analytical workflows, ensuring statistical methods are applied appropriately and outputs are communicated clearly.

postings.title: Workplace Services Lead East
postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Purpose of Role:

Serve as WPP's senior Workplace Services representative across an assigned portfolio, with overall responsibility for stakeholder relationships, workplace outcomes, financial stewardship and alignment with WPP & REWS standards, providing client-side operational governance.

Translate business priorities into workplace requirements and ensure outsourced service providers deliver against WPP standards, financial objectives and contractual commitments. 

Individual Accountabilities:

- WPP Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as the primary REWS relationship lead for assigned businesses and senior stakeholders, translating business priorities and employee needs into workplace requirements and outcomes.

- Workplace Strategy & Experience: Ensure workplace services, space and experience align with WPP strategy, utilization objectives, employee needs and global standards. Oversee space planning activities and portfolio optimization initiatives to support effective workplace outcomes.

- Financial Stewardship: Work with Finance stakeholders to prepare annual budgets and quarterly forecasts for the assigned portfolio, monitoring variances and savings opportunities. Challenge service-provider proposals and ensure spend aligns with approved WPP priorities.

- Service Provider Governance: Hold outsourced providers accountable for contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs, financial targets and service outcomes. Challenge performance gaps and ensure corrective action is taken by provider leadership.

- Risk & Operational Governance: Ensure assigned properties comply with WPP and REWS risk, governance and operational excellence standards. Lead the identification, oversight, management and escalation of material resilience and service risks and incidents, ensuring appropriate governance, incident management and timely resolution across the assigned portfolio.

- HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP & REWS Health, Safety, Security and Environmental policies and Business Continuity certification process, and other operational standards, partnering with relevant WPP functions and service providers as required.

- Performance & Insights: Use service-provider reporting, workplace data and stakeholder feedback to assess performance, identify continuous improvement opportunities and inform WPP decision-making.

Role Boundary:

The assigned portfolio may comprise a mix of campus and non-campus locations, requiring the AWSL to apply a flexible and adaptive approach to oversight, governance and stakeholder engagement in line with the evolving REWS operating model.

This is a WPP client-side leadership and governance role.

Day-to-day operational delivery and the direction, supervision and management of service-provider personnel remain the responsibility of the applicable service provider.

Onsite/In office role at one the larger campus locations within respective region.

Competencies, Knowledge and Experience:

Competencies:

- Strategic Service Provider Relationship: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with suppliers.

- Stakeholder Leadership and Business Partnership: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with stakeholders and understand their needs.

- Commercial and Contract Governance: Understand contractual commitments, SLAs/KPIs and commercial models to govern provider performance, contract compliance and support WPP decision-making.

- Leadership: Ability to lead through influence, establish clear client expectations to include stakeholder needs and hold service-provider leadership accountable for agreed outcomes.

- Digital Dexterity: Ability to leverage workplace data, reporting and technology apply critical thinking to evaluate performance, inform decisions and challenge service-provider outcomes and provide accurate data to the central REWS team as required

- Collaboration: Excellent ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, service providers, and stakeholders to achieve common goals.

- Change Management: Lead WPP stakeholder engagement and business adoption associated with workplace change, partnering with service providers and REWS teams on implementation.

- Strategic Business Acumen: Understanding of the business context and how workplace services contribute to overall organizational goals.

- Responsible Procurement: Partner effectively with WPP Procurement to support responsible and sustainable supplier governance.

- Continuous Improvement: Ability to identify opportunities to improve workplace performance through data innovation and best practice.

- Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning, professional development and the adoption of industry best practices to support the evolving REWS operating model.

Key Shared Accountabilities:

- Working with Global REWS Coe teams to implement global standards and initiatives.

- Collaborating with ET to ensure seamless technology integration in the workplace.

- Partnering with HR to support employee well-being and engagement programs.

- Working with Security to ensure a safe and secure environment.

- Working with Procurement to ensure any changes or new contracts are routed through to this team.

Key Interfaces:

- Regional Director REWS (Reporting Line)

- Regional Procurement

- Regional PMO

- Outsourced FM Provider Leadership

- Food & Beverage Providers

- Global REWS COE Team

- ET Department

- People Department

- Business Unit Leaders

- Employees

- Landlords

- Sub-Contractors

Key Metrics and Targets:

Financial Performance: Performance against approved budgets and savings/value commitments.

- Service Provider Performance: Performance against agreed contractual SLAs/KPIs.

- Stakeholder Experience: Business and employee satisfaction with workplace services.

- Portfolio Effectiveness: Space utilization and alignment with WPP workplace objectives.

- Governance & Risk: Effective oversight and escalation of material operational , resilience and service risks.

- HSSE & Business Continuity Compliance: Compliance with WPP and REWS Health, Safety, Security & Environmental (HSSE) standards, Business Continuity Planning (BCP) requirements and associated certification processes across the assigned portfolio.

- Sustainability: Performance against agreed WPP and REWS sustainability targets across the assigned portfolio, including energy consumption and other applicable environmental commitments.

Critical Knowledge & Experience:

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, build trusted relationships and drive alignment across a complex environment.

- 5–7+ years in corporate workplace, CRE, workplace experience or outsourced-service governance, preferably within a complex global organization.

- Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications in workplace, facilities management, corporate real estate or related disciplines are desirable.

- Demonstrated experience operating as an intelligent client within an outsourced FM environment and holding strategic service partners accountable for performance.

- Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience of budget development and forecasting and governing complex service-provider relationships through budgets, contracts, SLAs/KPIs and performance frameworks.

- Understanding of workplace management systems, reporting and data analytics, with the ability to interpret outputs and use insights to support decision-making, performance management and service-provider governance.

- In-depth knowledge of HSSE regulations and best practices

- Strong understanding of workplace strategy, space planning principles and portfolio optimization practices.

- Experience leading complex workplace, transformation or change initiatives across multiple locations and stakeholder groups.

- Knowledge of sustainability principles and practices.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

WPP Media Japan is revolutionizing the advertising industry through the power of data and artificial intelligence. At WPP Media, our vision for the Influencer Solutions team (GOAT) is to become the leading data-driven influencer consultancy. 

Purpose of Role

The Head of Influencer Solutions is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic direction, commercial success, and operational excellence of the agency's influencer marketing practice in Japan. This role combines strategic thought leadership with senior client stewardship, leading a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery to drive significant growth and establish the agency as the leading influencer solutions partner in the market. The Head of Influencer Solutions is accountable for financial ownership, team development, and defining the future of influencer marketing for our clients and the agency.

Key Responsibilities

The below are the key responsibilities for this role:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

- Define and execute the long-term strategic vision for the influencer solutions practice in Japan, setting clear objectives for growth, innovation, and market positioning.

- Lead all strategic thinking for the agency's top-tier influencer clients and most critical new business pitches, acting as the senior strategic voice and trusted advisor.

- Translate complex client business problems into clear, powerful strategic platforms that solve real business challenges through influencer marketing.

- Champion innovative approaches to influencer marketing, pushing the agency and its clients beyond conventional thinking to leverage emerging platforms, creator trends, and cultural movements.

- Act as a thought leader both internally and externally, representing the agency at industry events, contributing to market discourse, and elevating the agency's reputation.

Client Leadership & Growth

- Act as the senior strategic lead and trusted advisor across a portfolio of the agency's most important influencer marketing clients.

- Build and nurture strong, influential relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers, positioning yourself as an indispensable strategic partner.

- Lead long-term strategic account planning, including annual planning sessions and quarterly business reviews, ensuring the agency's services are deeply aligned with clients' core business objectives.

- Lead all major commercial negotiations, including contract renewals, new service proposals, and multi-year partnership agreements.

Commercial Ownership & P&L Management

- Take full ownership of the P&L for the influencer solutions practice, including revenue targets, forecasting, profitability, and resource allocation.

- Develop and execute ambitious growth strategies to drive significant year-on-year revenue growth across existing clients and new business.

- Identify and convert opportunities for deep strategic partnerships, multi-service integration, and expansion into new verticals and client categories.

- Oversee pricing strategies, margin management, and commercial negotiations to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.

- Lead new business development efforts, directing the team in winning major pitches and expanding the agency's client portfolio.

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-disciplinary team across account management, strategy, and campaign delivery functions, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and collaboration.

- Set clear performance expectations and manage the career development and growth of all team members, ensuring high levels of motivation, retention, and effectiveness.

- Build and scale the team in line with business growth, recruiting top talent and ensuring the right capabilities are in place to meet client and market demands.

- Act as the senior escalation point for complex client challenges, commercial issues, and executional risks, providing expert guidance and decisive leadership.

- Create a high-performance culture that attracts and retains the best talent in the influencer marketing industry.

Operational Excellence & Innovation

- Oversee the end-to-end quality of all deliverables across the influencer solutions practice, from strategic planning to campaign execution and reporting.

- Define and implement best practices, processes, and workflows that drive efficiency, quality, and profitability across all client work.

- Drive innovation in methodologies, tools, and technologies, ensuring the agency remains at the forefront of the evolving influencer marketing landscape.

- Ensure the team consistently delivers insightful, data-driven results that demonstrate clear ROI and business impact for clients.

- Stay at the forefront of platform changes, cultural trends, regulatory developments, and market dynamics in Japan and globally.

Cross-Functional & Network Collaboration

- Partner with senior leadership across all agency functions and WPP network agencies to ensure seamless integration and delivery of best-in-class solutions.

- Represent the influencer solutions practice at the highest level in key client meetings, new business pitches, and strategic planning sessions.

- Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key platform partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, LINE, etc.), talent agencies, and industry bodies in Japan.

- Collaborate with regional and global influencer leads across the WPP network to share best practices and drive innovation.

Performance Requirements

- Achieving and exceeding annual revenue growth and profitability targets for the influencer solutions practice.

- Maintaining high client satisfaction, retention, and expansion across the portfolio of key accounts.

- Successful leadership, development, and retention of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team.

- A high win-rate on new business pitches and demonstrable growth in the agency's market share.

- Consistent delivery of high-quality, innovative, and effective strategic work that drives measurable business results for clients.

- Strong reputation and visibility as a thought leader in the Japanese influencer marketing industry.

Skills and Competencies

- Proven, extensive experience in a senior leadership role within influencer marketing, social media, or digital marketing, ideally within an agency environment in Japan or APAC.

- A strong track record of building, leading, and scaling successful teams across multiple functions (account management, strategy, campaign delivery).

- Exceptional strategic thinking and commercial acumen, with demonstrated success in driving significant revenue growth and managing P&L.

- Outstanding leadership and mentoring capabilities, with the ability to inspire and develop diverse teams.

- Deep expertise in influencer marketing across all major platforms, with a strong understanding of the Japanese social media landscape, creator economy, and cultural nuances.

- Proven ability to build and maintain trusted C-suite level relationships with major clients and senior stakeholders.

- Expert-level communication and presentation skills in both Japanese and English, with the ability to command a room and articulate complex strategies with clarity.

- Strong collaborative skills and experience working across matrix organizations and agency networks (WPP experience highly valued).

- A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and growth.

- Open. We cultivate trust by taking ownership and accountability, and we empathetically and intelligently balance people and client experience in everything we do. 

- Optimistic. We mobilize the enterprise, driving our vision forward, and we champion growth and career development so we can all thrive. 

- Extraordinary. We harness our shared capabilities to inspire transformational creativity, and lead collectively to deliver a seamless client and colleague experience.

WPP Media is WPP’s media investment group and the world’s leading media investment company with a mission to shape the next era of media where advertising works better for people. For more information, visit WPP.com.

The Role:

The Transcreation Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for project managing localisation work for the clients Marketing Communications (Marcom) team. The TAM works closely with the clients Marcom Project Manager and a network of creative talents from various markets. This person needs to engage with other cross-functional teams of producers and project managers to ensure work is delivered on time, on quality and within budget. Constant need to communicate and negotiate priorities and deadlines with internal and external teams to ensure expectations are well managed is required. Primary tasks include organising and coordinating schedules, distributing workload, tracking progress of projects and allocated budget.

You will be responsible for project managing localization projects (incl. Transcreation of headlines) ensuring good communication with all stakeholders.

You will focus on building strong relationship with the Client Talent Network and briefing new projects accurately. Strong organization and time management skills when managing Clients, with focus on quality.

Key Responsibilities: 

Validator Network Management

- Ensure a thorough understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements, SOW and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant

- Manage a network of creative people and ensure they are motivated to perform

- Coordinate weekly status meetings/monthly review sessions

- Organize teamwork, create a balanced work schedule and ensure work is of high standards and delivered on time

- Flag any potential team issues to the line manager and be actively involved in finding a solution

- Review talent performance and drive constant performance improvement by working closely with talent manager and providing regular feedback on all talent

- Highlight and resolve quality control issues with the network

Project & Account Management

- Coordinate and ensure all parties follow the agreed workflows and manage them through the process

- Work alongside and support client’s Traffic Manager when briefing and tracking projects through to completion

- Ensure that there is clear division and allocation of workload among team members

- Ensure that trackers are updated at all times

- Monitor timelines and manage client expectations

- Monitor budget utilization and flag potential issues

- Monitor internal workflows and identify areas for improvement

- Advise line manager on resource gaps and flag potential issues

- Plan resources for large overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs

- Work closely with talent manager in delivering recruitment briefs on time

- Ensure account delivers consistently against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs

- Identify bottle necks/pain points for the validation network, suggest resolution and advise

- Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow

- Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters

- Lead overseas projects for up to 3 weeks (2 – 3 times per year)

Finance Management

- Quarterly planning

- Regular budget spend reports – monitor and analyse progression of spends

- Flag important budget fluctuations, peaks to the Client and line manager and track spend progress

- Monthly financial reconciliation

- Ensure full compliance with all financial procedures and policies

Client Management

- Co-ordinate between all relevant parties: Hogarth team, Client traffic and cross-functional teams and Validation network

- Set and manage client expectations for deliverables and timeframes

- Understand and work under the confidentiality policy

- Build strong, trusting relationships with all key client stakeholders

Requirements:

- A minimum of 4 years Project Management/Traffic background in an ad agency or in-house creative department

- Experience managing multi-market projects

- Experience working on global brands, ideally across all media, including print, interactive and film

- Demonstrable experience managing total creative workflow, i.e, internal briefing, briefing to vendors/studios, managing key milestones/deadlines, presentations/internal approvals, executions, delivery

- Proven project management skills

- Self-driven, organized and have an eye for detail

- Proficient with technology and tools

- Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in high-pressure situations and tight time frames

- A hands-on, can do approach to solving problems

- Fluent written and spoken English and Japanese

- Must be able to travel as required, sometimes several weeks at a time

ポジション概要

**Transcreation Account Manager（TAM）**は、クライアントのマーケティングコミュニケーション（Marcom）チームにおける、ローカライゼーション案件のプロジェクトマネジメントを担当するポジションです。

クライアント側のMarcom Project Managerや、各市場のクリエイティブ人材ネットワークと密接に連携しながらプロジェクトを進行します。また、プロデューサーやプロジェクトマネージャーなどの部門横断チームとも協働し、納期・品質・予算を管理しながら、プロジェクトを円滑に進行することが求められます。

社内外の関係者と継続的にコミュニケーションを取り、優先順位や納期を調整・交渉しながら、関係者の期待値を適切にマネジメントすることも重要な役割です。

主な業務には、スケジュールの策定・調整、業務の割り振り、プロジェクトの進捗管理、予算管理などが含まれます。

また、ヘッドラインのトランスクリエーションを含むローカライゼーションプロジェクト全体を管理し、すべてのステークホルダーとの円滑なコミュニケーションを図ります。

Client Talent Networkとの良好な関係構築や、新規プロジェクトにおける正確なブリーフィングも担当します。品質を重視しながら複数の案件やクライアントを管理するため、高い組織力とタイムマネジメント能力が求められます。

主な業務内容

Validator Network Management

バリデーターネットワークの管理

- 担当アカウントにおける契約上の義務、商務条件、SOW（業務範囲記述書）、SLA（サービスレベル合意書）を十分に理解し、必要に応じてチーム全体にも共有・浸透させる

- クリエイティブ人材のネットワークを管理し、パフォーマンスを発揮できる環境を整える

- 週次のステータスミーティングおよび月次レビューを調整・運営する

- チームの業務を整理し、適切なワークロードを設定するとともに、高い品質を維持しながら期限内に業務が完了するよう管理する

- チーム内で発生する可能性のある問題を上長に共有し、解決策の検討・実行に積極的に関与する

- Talent Managerと密接に連携し、各メンバーへの定期的なフィードバックを通じて継続的なパフォーマンス向上を支援する

- ネットワーク内で発生する品質管理上の課題を特定し、解決する

Project & Account Management

プロジェクト・アカウント管理

- 関係者間の調整を行い、合意されたワークフローに沿ってプロジェクトが進行するよう管理する

- クライアント側のTraffic Managerと連携し、プロジェクトのブリーフィングから進捗管理、完了までをサポートする

- チームメンバー間の役割・業務分担を明確にする

- 各種プロジェクトトラッカーを常に最新の状態に保つ

- スケジュールを管理し、クライアントの期待値を適切にコントロールする

- 予算の使用状況をモニタリングし、問題が発生する可能性がある場合は早期に共有する

- 社内ワークフローを確認し、改善できる領域を特定する

- リソース不足や潜在的な問題について上長に報告・提案する

- 大規模な海外プロジェクトのリソース計画を行い、新たな採用が必要となる場合はTalent Managerおよび上長へ共有する

- Talent Managerと連携し、必要な採用要件・ブリーフを適切なタイミングで提供する

- SLAやKPIを含む、契約上求められるサービス水準を継続的に達成できるよう管理する

- Validation Networkにおけるボトルネックや課題を特定し、改善策を提案する

- チームメンバーがプロセスやワークフローを適切に遵守できるよう、必要なトレーニングを特定する

- 新入社員のオンボーディングについて計画・準備・実施する

- 年2～3回程度、最長3週間の海外プロジェクトをリードする

Finance Management

予算・財務管理

- 四半期ごとの計画策定

- 定期的な予算使用状況レポートの作成、および支出状況のモニタリング・分析

- 大きな予算変動や支出の増加が発生した場合、クライアントおよび上長へ共有し、その後の支出状況を管理する

- 月次の財務照合作業

- すべての財務関連プロセスおよびポリシーを遵守する

Client Management

クライアントマネジメント

- Hogarthチーム、クライアント側Trafficチーム、部門横断チーム、Validation Networkなど、すべての関係者間の調整を行う

- 成果物および納期についてクライアントの期待値を設定・管理する

- 機密保持に関するポリシーを理解し、それに沿って業務を遂行する

- クライアント側の主要なステークホルダーと、強固で信頼性の高い関係を構築する

応募要件

- 広告代理店または事業会社のインハウスクリエイティブ部門における、4年以上のプロジェクトマネジメントまたはトラフィックマネジメント経験

- 複数の国・市場にまたがるプロジェクトを管理した経験

- グローバルブランドに携わった経験。印刷物、デジタル／インタラクティブ、映像など、複数のメディアに関する経験があれば尚可

- クリエイティブ制作の一連のワークフローを管理した実務経験

postings.title: WPP SSC MY | Thai Speaker | Senior Finance Analyst - PTP (Account Payable/Invoice/Payment)
postings.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
